summary: Iteration 2 fully tested. All 6 new backend review endpoint tests pass (create with idempotency, sanitized GET, 404 for invalid tokens, approve + clear persistence). End-to-end frontend flow verified: WAFLOW branding with Fascinads logo on white background (no black bg) on home, MagicLinkCard on 'Panel cliente' generates a public URL, Copiar button updates to 'Copiado', PublicReviewPage /review/{token} renders header+logo+project name+progress (0/73), reviewer-name flow enables approve/changes buttons, approve click hits backend and updates progress (1/73 aprobados), and state persists across a hard reload (came from backend).

issues: Seeded project without updated_at shows 'Actualizado Invalid Date' (only noticed because test seeded a minimal project via /api/storage/set; real projects created via UI carry the field). Consider a safe fallback like 'Actualizado —' when updated_at is missing.

action_items: Optional: Guard date formatting on ProjectCard (show fallback when updated_at is missing).
Optional (carry-over from iter 1): still no data-testid on pre-existing screens, but all iter-2 new components have proper testids — no blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/review/{token}/approve trusts the client-supplied 'by' string — acceptable for a public-by-design flow, but worth documenting; there is no rate-limiting or CSRF protection. For production, consider rate limiting per token.

server.py _read_storage silently swallows JSON decoding errors and returns None; a corrupt projects_list would look like 'project not found' (404) with no hint — fine for UX, noisy for ops. Consider logging a warning.
App.jsx continues growing (3512 lines). PublicReviewPage is a good candidate to extract into its own file now that it is a standalone route.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 new review tests; prior suite unchanged)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the iter-2 scope (branding, magic link generation+copy, public review page, approve+persistence after reload)

test_credentials: No auth. Public review tokens are by design.
seed_data_creation: Created 'TEST Review Project' entry in wa_editor:projects_list via /api/storage/set (with id starting TEST_review_<hex>) so review_get can resolve it. Approvals written under wa_editor:p:<id>:approval were cleared to null at the end of the test. TEST_Webinar_Persist project was also used to manually approve flujo_a:M1 (visible in screenshots).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files in /app/backend/tests/: backend_test.py (iter 1, consumes LLM credits in test_ai_test_chat) and test_review.py (iter 2, no LLM). Run `pytest backend/tests/test_review.py -v` from /app for a no-credit verification. The UI router is a manual regex on window.location.pathname (App.jsx ~line 3504), so /review/:token works on full-page load but requires page.goto (not SPA-internal nav) to mount PublicReviewPage.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The only initial false-negative was 'WAFLOW text not visible' on the first automation pass; that was because the app auto-opened the last-used project (workspace view) rather than rendering the home, so the WAFLOW-bearing header was not mounted. Navigating back to the projects dashboard confirmed the WAFLOW brand + Fascinads logo render correctly on white background.
